title: World Of Baking
description: Have you ever wanted to bake donuts and other sweets in Minecraft? This is the mod for you.
body: Baking is now in Minecraft! This mod adds making donuts, chocolate, dough, and more. Some wheat and water can be turned into dough, and dough can be used for various recipes such as cooking it into bread or, with some more work, turning it into donuts. Chocolate bars are added as well, also used to make donuts. A recipe for creating slimeballs with dough and dye is in the mod too, for convenience.
